description: F1, prevented: a write that carries a client-supplied _id (create with id, compare-and-set overwrite) is refused; event.overwrite stays as the defence-in-depth flag; event.ingested = ingest time; client values overridden

script.source: def e = ctx.event; if (!(e instanceof Map)) { e = new HashMap(); ctx.event = e; } e.overwrite = ctx._id != null; ctx.remove("event.overwrite"); ctx.remove("event.ingested");
